statement: Dolphin's *emulated* MotionPlus has separate inactive and active register access, 0x04/0x05/0x07 mapping modes, delayed activation/deactivation, and six-byte 14-bit gyro packets with rate/discriminator flags. Nunchuk/Classic pass-through requires bit remapping and alternates with gyro data. Its autogenerated calibration and exact timings are emulator behavior, not evidence that external, early-integrated and TR retail devices have identical startup responses.
